body.x: Mokibo (CEO Eunhyung Cho) participates in CES 2024 in Las Vegas from January 9 to 12, showcasing its innovative “Fusion Keyboard,” gaining traction as the next-generation mainstream input device. The keyboard preserves the tactile sensation of mechanical keyboards while transforming into a large touchpad, addressing the shortcomings of virtual keyboards and offering a typing speed advantage. The built-in touchpad on the keyboard is more than three times larger than standard laptop touchpads, enhancing user experience.

Notably, the Fusion Keyboard eliminates the need for a separate mouse. Mokibo has successfully developed and mass-produced this technology, filing over 90 patents worldwide. A Mokibo spokesperson stated, “The Fusion Keyboard innovatively reduces weight and thickness, making it a compact keyboard suitable for portable devices. It overcomes the limitations of input devices on portable gadgets, enhances user efficiency, and minimizes arm movement, reducing muscle fatigue. Additionally, this innovation could reduce the 1,800 tons of mouse plastic waste discarded globally each year.”

The Fusion Keyboard incorporates revolutionary key switch technology, automatically transitioning the keyboard into a large touchpad based on the user’s intent. This 4-in-1 keyboard integrates a keyboard, touchpad, smart device stand, and keyboard cover, employing a non-contact capacitive touch switch. It supports efficient multi-pairing, allowing simultaneous connection to up to three Bluetooth devices. A 2-hour USB-C cable charge provides 60 hours of continuous use. The modern design, which transforms into a smart device stand cover, includes water resistance, lightweight construction, and thinness, offering users convenience and versatility.

Mokibo introduced the first generation of Fusion Keyboard in 2019, followed by a significantly improved second generation in 2022, securing over 2.5 billion KRW in global crowdfunding and gaining recognition for its market potential. Currently, six models of the Fusion Keyboard are available in the market, expanding through various sales channels in the United States, Korea, Japan, and Europe.

body.cap: Fusion Keyboard attached to a smartphone │ Photo by Mokibo.

body.x: Regarding the participation in CES 2024, a Mokibo representative stated, “Mokibo has decided to showcase the successfully developed and mass-produced Fusion Keyboard to the global market, strengthening cooperation with major global laptop and tablet PC manufacturers. Furthermore, we aim to enhance collaboration with key international buyers and sales channels to expedite the global release of the completed Fusion Keyboard products presented at the exhibition.”

They added, “We are preparing to release the third generation Fusion Keyboard in 2024, with substantial improvements in touch performance and multi-gesture functionality. Additionally, in the first half of 2024, we plan to launch the Free Angle Stand Cover, innovatively addressing inconveniences in traditional tablet PC stand covers. Alongside this, we will continue to release various mobile accessories that improve user discomfort using Mokibo’s unique ideas. Mokibo strives to establish itself as a leader in the market by providing users with a new input experience through the Fusion Keyboard.”
